text:
tess: Kicking off staged rollout for v3.6.0 canary (5%) in us-east-1 in ~3m. Change window 18:00-19:00 UTC. Preflight green but QA harness will also run schema checks after first bump.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks PASS. Canary group created (5% traffic) and smoke tests deployed.

qa-automation-bot: QA-bot: post-deploy eval: structured-output schema validation FAIL (canary eu-lite pool) — 37% sample failures vs 0.8% baseline. See report: https://ci.internal/qa/reports/1840005432

yusuf: link shows missing keys and malformed json in function call outputs. Samples:```
{"id":"r1","intent":null,"slots":[]}
{"id":"r2","intent":"create","slots":"should-be-array-not-string"}
```

maya: that's bad. No 5xxs, but downstream app expects strict schema. Could be a tokenizer/decoder ordering tweak or a post-processing regression in v3.6.0.

sre-oncall: infra healthy. No mem/eviction anomalies. This is functional/regression in model output.

tess: Options: 1) pause rollout and pin canary to v3.5.9-schema-safe 2) rollback canary to v3.5.9 full 3) proceed and risk breaking downstream. I'm leaning pause+pin to minimize customer impact while we triage.

release-manager: vote: pause+pin. Also flag in RN that structured-output regression detected; customers using Function Calls might be impacted.

yusuf: hold + pin. I'll prepare rollback steps if pin doesn't mitigate.

maya: hold. Also add INVEST ticket for ML eval team.

qa-automation-bot: QA-bot: additional context: failing cases concentrate on multi-function sequences and nested slot arrays. Repro steps attached to report.

tess: @deploy-bot please suspend further percent increases and make canary allocation sticky for pinning.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: traffic increase suspended per request.

yusuf: Pinning canary allocation canary-us-east-1-5 -> v3.5.9-schema-safe now...

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary pinned to v3.5.9-schema-safe (allocation: canary-us-east-1-5). Audit: deploy-audit/1840005432-pin.

qa-automation-bot: QA-bot: re-eval post-pin: structured-output schema validation PASS (sample run) — failure rate back to 0.9% within 2 minutes.

sre-oncall: monitoring: no infra regressions. Downstream service logs show fewer schema errors after the pin.

release-manager: RN snippet suggestion: "Temporarily pinned us-east-1 canary to v3.5.9-schema-safe due to structured-output schema validation failures observed on v3.6.0 canary; ML team investigating multi-function output ordering and post-processing." OK to include?

tess: Good. I'll update release notes and open INVEST-2188 for ML/QA triage. Also update rollback playbook with exact pin/unpin commands.

yusuf: I'll keep a rollback ready (steps + owners) in case pinned path doesn't hold. If ML provides a patch we can unpin and resume a cautious percent increase.

maya: Reopen this thread if we need to roll back or when ML posts a patch. For now hold at 5% pinned. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
